details.fellowshipSong: I Will Sing the Wondrous Story #537

list: Sunday, October 18 is the last day to turn in the questionnaire for the pastoral search committee. You can drop yours in the box in the foyer.
Our church picnic is Sunday, October 25 at 5:00 PM at Mark and Anne Deaton’s garage. They will provide soup and grilled cheese sandwiches. Please bring your favorite dessert.

Thank you so much for thinking of our family and for your kindness during this difficult time. Your generosity and support have meant so much to us and have been a great comfort as we grieve the loss of our beloved husband, father and grandfather. With gratitude, Pat Williams & Family

fighterVerse.text: … My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.
